$comment: GENERATED by scripts/sync-permissions.mjs from the backend config/permissions.json and config/roles.json. Do not edit.

permissions.label: View my identity
permissions.description: Read the signed-in identity: tenant, roles, effective permissions and directory status.

permissions.label: Request access
permissions.description: Self-registration: ask for access with a role (routed through access.request).

permissions.label: Accept invitation
permissions.description: First sign-in of an invited user: link the sign-in and activate.

permissions.label: Sign out
permissions.description: End the current session (revokes the refresh-token family).

permissions.label: Choose my sign-in second step
permissions.description: Set up an authenticator app or use e-mailed codes for one's own sign-in (ADR-0017).

permissions.label: Change my password
permissions.description: Change the password of my local account (email + password mode).

permissions.label: Step-up verification
permissions.description: Re-authenticate with a one-time code to approve high-value items.

permissions.label: View users
permissions.description: List and open users in the tenant directory.

permissions.label: Export users
permissions.description: Download the user directory (users.csv; personal data).

permissions.label: Invite users
permissions.description: Request a user invitation (routed through user.invite).

permissions.label: Change user roles
permissions.description: Request a user role change (routed through user.role-change).

permissions.label: Deactivate users
permissions.description: Request a user deactivation (routed through user.deactivate).

permissions.label: Reactivate users
permissions.description: Request a user reactivation (routed through user.reactivate).

permissions.label: View roles
permissions.description: Read the tenant role catalogue (names, tiers, module access, permissions).

permissions.label: Create custom roles
permissions.description: Request a custom role cloned from an existing role (routed through role.custom-change).

permissions.label: Update custom roles
permissions.description: Request a change to a custom role's name or description (routed through role.custom-change).

permissions.label: Delete custom roles
permissions.description: Request deletion of an unassigned custom role (routed through role.custom-change).

permissions.label: Change role permissions
permissions.description: Request grants/revocations of permissions for a role (routed through role.permissions-change).

permissions.label: View permission groups
permissions.description: See permission groups, their grants and members.

permissions.label: Create permission groups
permissions.description: Request a new permission group (routed through permission-group.change).

permissions.label: Rename permission groups
permissions.description: Request a name / description change of a group (routed through permission-group.change).

permissions.label: Delete permission groups
permissions.description: Request deletion of a group without active members (routed through permission-group.change).

permissions.label: Change group permissions
permissions.description: Request grants / revocations of a group (protected identity permissions are role-only; routed through permission-group.change).

permissions.label: Change group members
permissions.description: Request adding or removing users, with an optional end date (routed through permission-group.membership).

permissions.label: View Entra role mapping
permissions.description: See which Entra groups and app roles map to platform roles.

permissions.label: Change Entra role mapping
permissions.description: Request adding or removing an Entra group / app-role -> role mapping (routed through entra-mapping.change).

permissions.label: View permission catalogue
permissions.description: Read the permission catalogue that guards every view and action.

permissions.label: View business rules
permissions.description: Read business rules and the tenant's effective values.

permissions.label: Request rule change
permissions.description: Request a business rule change (routed through rule.change).

permissions.label: View my approvals
permissions.description: Operations the signed-in user can decide now.

permissions.label: View requests
permissions.description: My requests and operation details visible to me (requester, deciders, route roles).

permissions.label: Decide operations
permissions.description: Approve, reject or return a step (route roles, four-eyes, segregation of duties and step-up still apply).

permissions.label: Withdraw my requests
permissions.description: The requester withdraws an open operation.

permissions.label: View workflows
permissions.description: Effective workflow definitions per operation type.

permissions.label: Apply my own changes without a second approval
permissions.description: Final approver: one's own configuration and administration requests (rules, workflows, templates, roles, permissions, groups, users, Entra mapping) apply at once where the workflow allows it. Business transactions keep four-eyes (ADR-0018).

permissions.label: Request workflow change
permissions.description: Change approval steps, approvers or SLAs (routed through workflow.change).

permissions.label: View events & hooks
permissions.description: Event points, hook points and operation types.

permissions.label: Toggle extensions
permissions.description: Enable or disable a hook handler or subscriber (routed through extension.toggle).

permissions.label: Preview notification templates
permissions.description: Render a template with sample data.

permissions.label: Send test notification
permissions.description: Send a template test to myself.

permissions.label: View e-mail outbox
permissions.description: E-mail outbox with delivery status (addresses are personal data).

permissions.label: Send e-mail through the notification service
permissions.description: Machine client: submit an e-mail to credigit-ser-notification-service (POST /api/v1/emails). Enforced by the notification service.

permissions.label: View e-mail delivery status
permissions.description: Machine client: read an e-mail delivery from credigit-ser-notification-service (GET /api/v1/emails/{id}). Enforced by the notification service.

permissions.label: Accept AI flag
permissions.description: Accept an AI-flagged exception from the dashboard.

permissions.label: Dismiss AI flag
permissions.description: Dismiss an AI flag from the dashboard.

permissions.label: View profile & security
permissions.description: My profile, sessions and security settings.

permissions.label: Preview branding
permissions.description: Personal brand preview (not saved for the tenant).

permissions.label: Request brand change
permissions.description: Request a tenant brand change (routed through brand.change).

permissions.label: View audit log
permissions.description: Read the immutable audit log (viewing is itself audited).

permissions.label: Request sector limit change
permissions.description: Change sectoral concentration limits (routed through admin.sector-limits.change).

permissions.label: View cockpit
permissions.description: CRO / Head of Risk cockpit, KRIs and sector heat-map.

permissions.label: View Board Risk Committee pack
permissions.description: The BRC pack and its history.

permissions.label: Submit executive summary
permissions.description: Submit the AI executive summary for sign-off (executive.summary.signoff).

permissions.label: Build BRC pack
permissions.description: Build the BRC pack for a period.

permissions.label: Submit BRC pack
permissions.description: Route the BRC pack for approval (executive.brc-pack.approve).

permissions.label: View AI query console
permissions.description: Natural-language query console over the Risk Data Spine.

permissions.label: Start AI conversation
permissions.description: Start a new conversation in the console.

permissions.label: View AI activity
permissions.description: AI outputs and those awaiting my sign-off.

permissions.label: Sign off AI output
permissions.description: Human sign-off of an AI draft or flag (ai.output.sign-off).

permissions.label: View applications
permissions.description: The credit pipeline and application details (customer data).

permissions.label: View my origination queue
permissions.description: Applications where I can act now.

permissions.label: View approval chart-flows
permissions.description: Approval routes by amount and flow.

permissions.label: Create applications
permissions.description: Create a draft credit request (initiator role group).

permissions.label: Upload documents
permissions.description: Upload customer documents / audited financials for OCR.

permissions.label: Sign off credit memo
permissions.description: Edit and sign off the AI-drafted credit memo.

permissions.label: Run limit gate
permissions.description: Run the single-obligor / sector limit check.

permissions.label: Record analysis outcome
permissions.description: Record limit gate, system recommendation and COP Ratio (analyst role group).

permissions.label: Request limit exception
permissions.description: Ask the CRO / Board for a limit exception (origination.limit-exception).

permissions.label: Request recommendation override
permissions.description: Override the system recommendation with a reason (origination.recommendation-override).

permissions.label: Tag covenants
permissions.description: Tag covenants and conditions for the offer letter.

permissions.label: Submit for approval
permissions.description: Route an application into the credit chart-flow (credit.facility-approval).

permissions.label: Release to offer letter
permissions.description: Release an approved application to the offer-letter stage.

permissions.label: Comment on applications
permissions.description: Add a credit committee comment with mentions.

permissions.label: View my 360 RAR requests
permissions.description: Requests awaiting my decision or raised by me.

permissions.label: Export 360 RAR data
permissions.description: Download assessments, parameters, benchmarks, outliers, corpus and share-of-wallet CSVs.

permissions.label: Accept advisory note
permissions.description: Submit the AI advisory note for sign-off (rar.advisory-signoff).

permissions.label: View house template
permissions.description: House template, merge fields and versions.

permissions.label: Comment on offer letters
permissions.description: Add a comment to a letter.

permissions.label: Send for Legal sign-off
permissions.description: Route a letter for Legal sign-off and issue (offer-letters.letter.signoff).

permissions.label: Submit house template
permissions.description: Submit a template version for Legal sign-off (offer-letters.template.approve).

permissions.label: Propose clause change
permissions.description: Create or change a library clause (offer-letters.clause.change).

permissions.label: View CRMS desk
permissions.description: CRMS reporting queue and search log.

permissions.label: Export credit administration data
permissions.description: Download facility, waiver, CRMS and credit-file CSVs.

permissions.label: Confirm conditions precedent
permissions.description: Tick a condition precedent met or reopen it.

permissions.label: Sanction for breach
permissions.description: Request a sanction for a breach (credit-admin.sanction).

permissions.label: Update credit file
permissions.description: Mark a credit-file item received or outstanding.

permissions.label: Export disbursements
permissions.description: Download the disbursement queue and history.

permissions.label: Prepare disbursement
permissions.description: Maker prepares a disbursement within the approved amount (disbursement.authorise).

permissions.label: Authorise disbursement
permissions.description: Checker authorises, rejects or returns (no self-approval; step-up applies).

permissions.label: View covenants & inflows
permissions.description: Covenants, inflows, periodic reviews and fees.

permissions.label: Export monitoring data
permissions.description: Download past-due, covenant, inflow, periodic, fee, APG, TOD, alert and ageing CSVs.

permissions.label: Assign officer
permissions.description: Assign a monitoring officer to a facility.

permissions.label: Add monitoring note
permissions.description: Add a note to a facility.

permissions.label: Review exception
permissions.description: Start or re-open an exception review.

permissions.label: Record covenant test
permissions.description: Record a covenant test result with evidence.

permissions.label: Review AI inflow flag
permissions.description: Accept or dismiss an AI inflow flag.

permissions.label: Update guarantee status
permissions.description: Crystallise, record a call/claim, or update an overdraft.

permissions.label: View legal review
permissions.description: Searches, perfection tasks, document vault and sign-off.

permissions.label: Export collateral data
permissions.description: Download collateral, legal, vault, sign-off, verification and share CSVs.

permissions.label: Upload collateral documents
permissions.description: Upload documents or a CSCS valuation.

permissions.label: Advance perfection
permissions.description: Advance a perfection step; report or cure defects.

permissions.label: Manage security documents
permissions.description: Confirm genuineness, vault, check out and return documents.

permissions.label: Export portfolio data
permissions.description: Download portfolio, limit, concentration, WARR, RAROC, projection and plan CSVs.

permissions.label: Submit plan
permissions.description: Submit a plan version for approval (portfolio.plan.approve).

permissions.label: Export IFRS 9 data

permissions.label: Submit model version
permissions.description: Submit a model version for validation (ifrs9.model.approval).

permissions.label: Review AI model finding
permissions.description: Accept or dismiss an AI model finding.

permissions.label: View market risk
permissions.description: Market risk and the breach log.

permissions.label: Export market-risk data
permissions.description: Download breach log, top depositors and stress runs.

permissions.label: Raise early warning
permissions.description: Raise and escalate a liquidity early warning.

permissions.label: Update ILAAP
permissions.description: Rescore risk factors, review chapters and compile.

permissions.label: Run stress scenario
permissions.description: Run and save a stress scenario.

permissions.label: Submit stress scenario
permissions.description: Submit a stress run for approval (market-risk.stress.approve).

permissions.label: Export operational-risk data

permissions.label: Escalate KRI
permissions.description: Escalate a KRI to the next level.

permissions.label: Log loss event
permissions.description: Log a loss event or near miss.

permissions.label: Run self-assessment
permissions.description: Start an RCSA and complete actions.

permissions.label: Submit BCM plan review
permissions.description: Submit a plan review for approval (operational-risk.bcm.plan-approval).

permissions.label: Export enterprise-risk data
permissions.description: Download scorecard, register, insider and regulatory CSVs.

permissions.label: Assess circular
permissions.description: Start an impact assessment or link to a policy.

permissions.label: Load workspace data
permissions.description: Load the data the screens work on from the database (baseline; ADR-0015).

permissions.label: Save workspace data
permissions.description: Save the changes the screens make to the database (baseline; ADR-0015).

permissions.label: View workspace data
permissions.description: List workspace stores, collections and documents.

permissions.label: Edit workspace data directly
permissions.description: Create, replace or delete single workspace documents (reason required, audited).

permissions.label: Read master data
permissions.description: Read active master-data values (drop-downs, validation). Baseline: every signed-in user.

permissions.label: See master-data history
permissions.description: See retired values and the change history of master data.

permissions.label: Change master data
permissions.description: Request adding, updating, retiring or reactivating master-data values (routed through master-data.value.change).

permissions.label: Export master data
permissions.description: Download a master-data list as CSV.

permissions.label: View and download documents
permissions.description: List and download the documents of records you work on. Baseline: the owning module's subject policy decides which records.

permissions.label: Upload documents
permissions.description: Upload documents and new versions. Baseline: the owning module's subject policy decides who may upload for which record.

permissions.label: Verify documents
permissions.description: Verify or reject a document version (never your own upload while documents.verify.segregation is on).

permissions.label: Attach extracted data
permissions.description: OCR connector (service identity): attach extracted fields to a version.

permissions.label: Request document deletion
permissions.description: Request deletion of a document or version (routed through documents.document.delete, four-eyes).

permissions.label: Place legal holds
permissions.description: Place or lift a legal hold; a held document cannot be deleted or purged.

permissions.label: Search the document library
permissions.description: Search documents across every record you may see, including deleted ones.

permissions.label: Export the document library index
permissions.description: Download the library index as CSV.

permissions.label: Request retention purges
permissions.description: See documents past retention and request their purge (routed through documents.retention.purge).

permissions.description: See the active document store and whether it answers.
